mentions.name: Spine AI
mentions.description: A visual workspace for thinking across multiple AI models. Users can chat with, branch, and connect 300+ models on an infinite canvas to explore tradeoffs, check blind spots, and generate assets such as research, slides, prompts, and images from the same board. Tryable without signup.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on Spine AI, a visual workspace to think across multiple AI models.

You can chat, branch, and connect 300+ models on an infinite canvas: useful when you need to explore tradeoffs, check blind spots, or generate assets (research, slides, prompts, images) from the same board.
